item.title: [ZEPPELIN-4414] Upgrade thrift to 0.13
item.description:

Upgrading thrift to 0.13 might fix this issue since 0.12.0 had a major bug which could be related to Transport Exception we're seeing in Zeppelin. We've upgraded to thrift 0.13 and haven't been able to re-produce the same issue yet.  https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/THRIFT-4858

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: Thanks for reporting this issue amandeep.kaur

zjffdu I have tried upgrading libthrift to 0.13.0 and the exception still occurs while spark interpreter is restarting, except the the error message differs and that is because the fix for https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/THRIFT-4858 is only adding additional message [here|https://github.com/apache/thrift/pull/1876/commits/6c96e429d9a76cffe8fdd67322e124e2c4fbf374]. I am not sure how amandeep.kaur managed to fix this by upgrading. I guess this requires more work.

zjffdu I checkout the code related to this exception, it seems in 0.8.2 the exception is simply ignored, see https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/blob/v0.8.2/zeppelin-zengine/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/interpreter/remote/RemoteInterpreterManagedProcess.java#L230 . And Zeppelin is not crashed as described by amandeep.kaur, it still works except for this exception. If so, maybe we can ignore this exception again.

iamabug  zjffdu i believe for 0.9 this exception is also ignored and a warn message is logged https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/blob/master/zeppelin-zengine/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/interpreter/remote/RemoteInterpreterManagedProcess.java#L141

 

Without upgrading thrift i would see this exception without the warn message so it seemed like the exception would occur in a different place where it wasn't getting handled properly.

 

From the detailed message above that iamabug  posted the exception is handled with a warn message:
RemoteInterpreterManagedProcess.java[stop]:131) - Kill interpreter process WARN [2019-11-26 20:34:43,632] ({qtp2114874018-31} RemoteInterpreterManagedProcess.java[stop]:141) - ignore the exception when shutting downjava.lang.RuntimeException: org.apache.thrift.transport.TTransportException: Socket is closed by peer. at

amandeep.kaur I think the important thing here is whether this exception is causing anything to crash, if not, maybe ignoring the exception in Zeppelin is acceptable.  Also, I don't see how upgrading thrift would help here because it only changes the exception message.
iamabug Ah i see, makes sense. I got confused to not see the warn message as part of the logs when the exception occurred originally.
I think it make sense to just ignore this kind of exception to avoid confusion for users. iamabug amandeep.kaur

Issue resolved by pull request 3587
https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/3587
